{"diagnosis": "Fetch test with 256 NOPs asserts TRAP and reports tohost FAIL 0xdead instead of progressing. mem_rdata_latched in picorv32.v:388 selects mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle[31:16] (0x0000) for mem_la_firstword instead of [15:0] (0x0013), decoding as illegal compressed and trapping. Root cause is the wrong half-word select on the firstword path; fixing to [15:0] restores correct fetch alignment.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -386,3 +386,3 @@
 	assign mem_rdata_latched = COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word ? {16'bx, mem_16bit_buffer} :
 			COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_la_secondword ? {mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle[15:0], mem_16bit_buffer} :
-			COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_la_firstword ? {16'bx, mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle[31:16]} : mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle;
+			COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_la_firstword ? {16'bx, mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle[15:0]} : mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle;", "expected": "tohost PASS (not FAIL 0xdead), no TRAP: cpu trap asserted, fetch progress"}
